new.text: Figure 6.10: Adjust Method Class So the method wrapper class is not that complex. It just consists of two parts: An in- ner structure definition, which aggregates all OUT -/INOUT -parameters of the method, and a bracket operator, which is used to call the service method. The operator con- tains all of the service methods IN-/INOUT -parameters as IN-parameters. That means INOUT -parameters in the abstract service method description are split in a pair of IN and OUT parameters in the ara::com API. The return value of a call to a service method is an ara::com::Future, where the template parameter is of the type of the inner struct, which aggregates all OUT -parameters of the method. More about this ara::com::Future in the following subsection.
